SELECT MAX(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND 1.0 * s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT s.School, s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND t.NumGE1500 = (
    SELECT MAX(t2.NumGE1500)
    FROM schools AS s2
    JOIN satscores AS t2 ON t2.cds = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
      AND s2.School IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.District,
        s.County,
        t.AvgScrWrite,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS score_rank
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS t
        ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
      AND t.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
      AND t.rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT
    School,
    District,
    County,
    AvgScrWrite
FROM ranked
WHERE score_rank = 2;

WITH target_county AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT `County Code`
    FROM frpm
    WHERE CDSCode = '01612590125716'
),
qualifying_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`County Name` AS county_name,
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter_indicator,
        ROUND(
            f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0
            / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0),
            2
        ) AS free_meal_pct,
        ROUND(
            f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0
            / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0),
            2
        ) AS frpm_pct
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN target_county AS c
      ON f.`County Code` = c.`County Code`
    WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
      AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
),
sat_by_school AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS sat_score
    FROM satscores
)
SELECT
    q.county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(q.free_meal_pct), 2) AS average_free_meal_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(q.frpm_pct), 2) AS average_frpm_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q.charter_indicator = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q.charter_indicator = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(s.sat_score), 2) AS average_sat_score
FROM qualifying_schools AS q
LEFT JOIN sat_by_school AS s
  ON s.cds = q.CDSCode
GROUP BY q.county_name;

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       s.County AS county,
       s.District AS district,
       s.City AS city,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment,
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS k12_frpm_count,
       f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS k12_frpm_percentage,
       t.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,
       t.AvgScrRead AS average_reading_score,
       t.AvgScrMath AS average_math_score,
       t.AvgScrWrite AS average_writing_score,
       t.NumGE1500 AS test_takers_total_score_at_least_1500
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CDSCode = '01612590137943';

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS frpm_count,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) AS frpm_share
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f
        ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Charter = 0
      AND s.EdOpsName = 'Traditional'
      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100
),
extremes AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(frpm_count) AS max_frpm_count,
        MIN(frpm_share) AS min_frpm_share
    FROM candidates
),
parts AS (
    SELECT c.CDSCode, 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, 1 AS part_order
    FROM candidates AS c
    CROSS JOIN extremes AS e
    WHERE c.frpm_count = e.max_frpm_count

    UNION ALL

    SELECT c.CDSCode, 'smallest FRPM share' AS part, 2 AS part_order
    FROM candidates AS c
    CROSS JOIN extremes AS e
    WHERE c.frpm_share = e.min_frpm_share

    UNION ALL

    SELECT c.CDSCode, 'the CDS code from my notes' AS part, 3 AS part_order
    FROM candidates AS c
    WHERE c.CDSCode = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT
    p.part,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.County AS county,
    s.City AS city,
    s.MailStreet AS mailing_street,
    s.MailCity AS mailing_city,
    s.MailState AS mailing_state,
    s.MailZip AS mailing_ZIP,
    s.Website AS website,
    c.enrollment AS k12_enrollment,
    c.frpm_count AS frpm_eligible_student_count,
    c.frpm_share AS frpm_share,
    sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite AS average_total_sat_score,
    100.0 * sat.NumGE1500 / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS percentage_scoring_1500_or_more,
    s.OpenDate AS opening_date,
    CASE WHEN s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
FROM parts AS p
JOIN candidates AS c
    ON c.CDSCode = p.CDSCode
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.CDSCode = p.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = p.CDSCode
   AND sat.rtype = 'S'
ORDER BY p.part_order, s.CDSCode;

SELECT f.`County Name` AS county_name,
       COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s
  ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
GROUP BY f.`County Name`
ORDER BY qualifying_school_count DESC, county_name ASC;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS magnet_school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" IN ('Provision 2', 'Breakfast Provision 2', 'Lunch Provision 2')
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City;

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'borderless'
  AND (cardKingdomId IS NULL OR cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL);

WITH target AS (
    SELECT uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE power IS NULL OR instr(power, '*') > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN target.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT target.uuid),
    2
) AS percentage_with_french_translation
FROM target
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = target.uuid
   AND fd.language = 'French';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.code)
FROM sets AS s
JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age'
  AND st.language = 'Italian'
  AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(st.translation) <> '';

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE
        WHEN cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(cardKingdomId) <> ''
         AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(cardKingdomFoilId) <> ''
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'CSP';

SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS year_span
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power IN ('0', '1', '2');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.date || char(31) || r.text) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings AS r
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Fireball';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang'
  AND l.format = 'pauper'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND c.availability LIKE '%paper%';

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND side = 'a'
  AND otherFaceIds IS NOT NULL
  AND otherFaceIds <> ''
  AND frameVersion = (
      SELECT frameVersion
      FROM cards
      WHERE frameVersion IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

WITH qualifying_cards AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f.name AS japanese_card_name,
        c.type AS english_card_type
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN foreign_data AS f
        ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE lower(c.watermark) = 'boros'
      AND lower(f.language) = 'japanese'
),
card_printings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        q.japanese_card_name,
        q.english_card_type,
        c.uuid
    FROM qualifying_cards AS q
    JOIN foreign_data AS f
        ON f.name = q.japanese_card_name
       AND lower(f.language) = 'japanese'
    JOIN cards AS c
        ON c.uuid = f.uuid
       AND c.type = q.english_card_type
)
SELECT
    cp.japanese_card_name,
    cp.english_card_type,
    COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_total
FROM card_printings AS cp
LEFT JOIN rulings AS r
    ON r.uuid = cp.uuid
GROUP BY cp.japanese_card_name, cp.english_card_type
ORDER BY cp.japanese_card_name, cp.english_card_type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_printings
FROM cards
WHERE power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) > 3
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) <= 10;

SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS printings
FROM foreign_data
WHERE language IN (
    'Korean', 'Chinese Traditional', 'Russian', 'Chinese Simplified',
    'Portuguese (Brazil)', 'Spanish', 'Italian', 'German', 'French', 'Japanese'
)
GROUP BY language
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(printings)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS printings
        FROM foreign_data
        WHERE language IN (
            'Korean', 'Chinese Traditional', 'Russian', 'Chinese Simplified',
            'Portuguese (Brazil)', 'Spanish', 'Italian', 'German', 'French', 'Japanese'
        )
        GROUP BY language
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.colors = 'B'
  AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%'
  AND f.language <> 'English'
  AND TRIM(COALESCE(f.flavorText, '')) <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT ph.UserId
FROM postHistory AS ph
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = ph.PostId
WHERE p.ViewCount >= 1000
  AND ph.UserId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;

WITH posts_2012 AS (
    SELECT
        p.Id,
        p.Score,
        CASE
            WHEN u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
              OR u.Location LIKE '%Munich%'
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS germany_last_editor
    FROM posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN users AS u
        ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
),
german_editors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
    FROM posts_2012 AS p
    JOIN posts AS post
        ON post.Id = p.Id
    JOIN users AS u
        ON u.Id = post.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.germany_last_editor = 1
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN germany_last_editor = 1 THEN Score ELSE 0 END), 0) AS germany_last_editor_posts_total_score,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN germany_last_editor = 0 THEN Score ELSE 0 END), 0) AS all_other_posts_total_score,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM german_editors) AS germany_last_editor_user_count,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Reputation), 0) FROM german_editors) AS germany_editors_combined_reputation
FROM posts_2012;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.Score), 0) AS total_score
FROM posts AS p
WHERE p.PostTypeId = 1
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
  AND p.Id IN (
    SELECT pl.PostId
    FROM postLinks AS pl
    JOIN posts AS target
      ON target.Id = pl.RelatedPostId
    WHERE target.Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
    FROM users
    WHERE Location LIKE '%California%'
       OR UPPER(Location) GLOB 'CA'
       OR UPPER(Location) GLOB 'CA[^A-Z]*'
       OR UPPER(Location) GLOB '*[^A-Z]CA'
       OR UPPER(Location) GLOB '*[^A-Z]CA[^A-Z]*'
)
SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
FROM eligible
WHERE Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM eligible);

WITH matching_posts AS (
    SELECT Id, Title
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
related_posts AS (
    SELECT PostId AS post_id, RelatedPostId AS related_post_id
    FROM postLinks
    WHERE LinkTypeId = 1
    UNION
    SELECT RelatedPostId AS post_id, PostId AS related_post_id
    FROM postLinks
    WHERE LinkTypeId = 1
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.Id,
        p.Title,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.related_post_id) AS related_post_count
    FROM matching_posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN related_posts AS r
        ON r.post_id = p.Id
    GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title
)
SELECT Title, related_post_count
FROM counts
WHERE related_post_count = (
    SELECT MAX(related_post_count)
    FROM counts
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation), 2) AS avg_reputation
FROM users AS u
WHERE (
    LOWER(TRIM(u.Location)) = 'india'
    OR LOWER(TRIM(u.Location)) LIKE '%, india'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
      AND p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
);

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        CustomerID,
        total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Segment
            ORDER BY total, CustomerID
        ) AS rn
    FROM totals
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, total
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total END),
        2
    ) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total END),
        2
    ) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total END),
        2
    ) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM mins;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(Consumption), 2) AS average_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 15621
  AND Date >= '201301'
  AND Date < '201401'
  AND Consumption > 0;

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Currency,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
      AND y.Consumption IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
    AVG(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN annual_consumption END) -
    AVG(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN annual_consumption END)
)
FROM customer_totals;

WITH extremes AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        player_name,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS tallest_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height ASC) AS shortest_rank
    FROM Player
    WHERE height IS NOT NULL
),
average_finishing AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        AVG(finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE finishing IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT e.player_name
FROM extremes AS e
JOIN average_finishing AS a
    ON a.player_api_id = e.player_api_id
WHERE e.tallest_rank = 1 OR e.shortest_rank = 1
ORDER BY a.avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control END)
    - AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control END)
    AS mean_ball_control_difference
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');

SELECT MIN(pa.date) AS date
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    JOIN Player AS p2 ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id
    WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  );

WITH ranked_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        volleys,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_ratings AS r
    ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
  AND p.height > 180
  AND r.volleys > 70;

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM "Match"
),
counts AS (
    SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM Country c
    JOIN appearances a ON a.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_id
    WHERE p.weight <= 160
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT name, player_count
FROM counts
WHERE player_count = (SELECT MIN(player_count) FROM counts);

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.date,
        pa.id,
        pa.overall_rating,
        pa.defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
            ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
    WHERE pa.date <= '2013-07-12 23:59:59'
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT
        r.player_api_id,
        r.overall_rating
    FROM ranked AS r
    WHERE r.rn = 1
      AND r.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
      AND r.overall_rating IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(e.overall_rating) AS avg_rating,
        MAX(
            CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
                 THEN e.overall_rating END
        ) AS landon_rating
    FROM eligible AS e
    JOIN Player AS p
      ON p.player_api_id = e.player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND((landon_rating - avg_rating) * 100.0 / avg_rating, 2)
FROM stats;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976'
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR trim(t.k_symbol) = '');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM trans AS t
      WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
        AND t.bank = 'AB'
  );

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A11 AS avg_salary
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
      AND strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS average_district_salary,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH eligible_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp AS account_disp
          JOIN card AS ca ON ca.disp_id = account_disp.disp_id
          WHERE account_disp.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
      )
),
district_averages AS (
    SELECT ec.district_id, AVG(d.A11) AS avg_salary
    FROM eligible_clients AS ec
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ec.district_id
    GROUP BY ec.district_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2)
FROM district_averages;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.trans_id END) AS household_payments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''
         AND t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO'
        THEN t.trans_id
    END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM trans AS t
WHERE t.amount > 4000
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp AS d
      JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
      WHERE d.account_id = t.account_id
        AND c.gender = 'M'
        AND c.birth_date >= '1974-01-01'
        AND c.birth_date < '1977-01-01'
  );

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ca.type AS card_type,
        di.district_id,
        di.A2 AS district_name,
        CAST(di.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = cl.district_id
    WHERE ca.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        card_type,
        district_name,
        inhabitants,
        MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS fewest_inhabitants
    FROM eligible_districts
)
SELECT card_type, district_name, inhabitants
FROM ranked
WHERE inhabitants = fewest_inhabitants
ORDER BY card_type, district_name;

WITH withdrawals AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing_orders AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_debit
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
),
district_orders AS (
    SELECT a.district_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(so.total_debit, 0)) AS total_standing_order_debit,
           COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN standing_orders AS so ON so.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
           d.A3 AS region,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
           w.total_withdrawn,
           1.0 * w.total_withdrawn / CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
           RANK() OVER (
               ORDER BY 1.0 * w.total_withdrawn / CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
           ) AS withdrawal_rank,
           1.0 * do.total_standing_order_debit / do.account_count AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawals AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN district_orders AS do ON do.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
)
SELECT district_name,
       region,
       population,
       total_withdrawn,
       ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       withdrawal_rank,
       ROUND(avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM ranked
ORDER BY withdrawal_rank, district_name;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_withdrawn
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
counterparty_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bank || ':' || account) AS number_of_external_counterparties
    FROM trans
    WHERE bank IS NOT NULL
      AND account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    COALESCE(tt.total_amount_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
    COALESCE(tt.total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(lc.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(cc.number_of_external_counterparties, 0) AS number_of_external_counterparties,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(cc.number_of_external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS rank
FROM gold_accounts ga
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc ON lc.account_id = ga.account_id
LEFT JOIN counterparty_counts cc ON cc.account_id = ga.account_id
ORDER BY number_of_external_counterparties DESC, ga.account_id;

WITH cohort_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01' THEN 'young cohort'
            WHEN c.birth_date <= '1919-12-31' THEN 'old cohort'
        END AS cohort,
        a.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp
        ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.birth_date >= '1980-01-01'
       OR c.birth_date <= '1919-12-31'
)
SELECT
    cohort,
    ROUND(AVG(d.A11)) AS average_salary
FROM cohort_districts AS cd
JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = cd.district_id
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY CASE cohort
    WHEN 'young cohort' THEN 1
    WHEN 'old cohort' THEN 2
END;

WITH race_winners AS (
    SELECT raceId, laps
    FROM results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN entry.laps = winner.laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM results AS entry
JOIN drivers AS driver ON driver.driverId = entry.driverId
JOIN races AS race ON race.raceId = entry.raceId
JOIN race_winners AS winner ON winner.raceId = entry.raceId
WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY MIN(lt.milliseconds) ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url,
    d.dob,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(q.q3) NOT IN ('', '\N') THEN 1 END) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
      CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) = (
      SELECT MAX(
          CAST(substr(q2.q1, 1, instr(q2.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
          + CAST(substr(q2.q1, instr(q2.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
      )
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
      CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) = (
      SELECT MAX(
          CAST(substr(q2.q1, 1, instr(q2.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
          + CAST(substr(q2.q1, instr(q2.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
      )
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT other.driverId)
FROM qualifying AS lucas
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = lucas.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = lucas.driverId
JOIN qualifying AS other ON other.raceId = lucas.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2010
  AND d.forename = 'Lucas'
  AND d.surname = 'di Grassi'
  AND lucas.position IS NOT NULL
  AND other.position > lucas.position;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0 < 100;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_count), 2) AS average_q3_lap_times_per_driver
FROM (
  SELECT d.driverId,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(q.q3) <> '' THEN 1 END) AS q3_count
  FROM drivers d
  LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE d.dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.driverId
);

SELECT d.code, q.q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.number AS permanent_race_number, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL) < 98.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverId) AS withdrawn_drivers
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1962
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount END) * 1.0 /
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount END) AS ratio
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')
  AND b.category = 'Advertisement';

WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / SUM(b.amount) AS spending_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
SELECT event_name
FROM event_ratios
WHERE spending_ratio = (SELECT MAX(spending_ratio) FROM event_ratios);

WITH college_majors AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        major_name,
        department
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
major_member_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cm.major_id,
        cm.major_name,
        cm.department,
        COUNT(m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM college_majors AS cm
    LEFT JOIN "member" AS m
        ON m.link_to_major = cm.major_id
    GROUP BY cm.major_id, cm.major_name, cm.department
)
SELECT
    department AS department_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
        CASE WHEN member_count > 0 THEN major_name END,
        ', '
    ) AS majors_held_by_members,
    ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM major_member_counts
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department_name;

WITH events_2019 AS (
    SELECT event_id, type
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01'
      AND event_date < '2020-01-01'
),
attendance_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM events_2019 e
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
),
budget_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget
    FROM events_2019 e
    LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT
    t.type AS event_type,
    COALESCE(a.member_count, 0) AS members_attended,
    COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_budgeted_dollars
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT type FROM events_2019) t
LEFT JOIN attendance_by_type a ON a.type IS t.type
LEFT JOIN budget_by_type b ON b.type IS t.type
ORDER BY t.type;

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_dollars
FROM income AS i
WHERE i.source = 'Dues'
  AND i.link_to_member IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT a.link_to_member
      FROM attendance AS a
      JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
      WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
  );

WITH chip_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event AS event_id
    FROM expense x
    JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    WHERE lower(x.expense_description) LIKE '%chip%'
      AND x.cost > 0
),
event_max AS (
    SELECT ce.event_id, MAX(b.amount) AS max_line_amount
    FROM chip_events ce
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = ce.event_id
    GROUP BY ce.event_id
)
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event_max em
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = em.event_id
WHERE em.max_line_amount = (SELECT MAX(max_line_amount) FROM event_max);

WITH RECURSIVE items(expense_id, item, rest) AS (
    SELECT e.expense_id, '', e.expense_description || ','
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(b.category)) = 'food'
      AND e.expense_description IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT expense_id,
           TRIM(SUBSTR(rest, 1, INSTR(rest, ',') - 1)),
           SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1)
    FROM items
    WHERE rest <> ''
      AND INSTR(rest, ',') > 0
),
item_counts AS (
    SELECT LOWER(item) AS item_key,
           MIN(item) AS item_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT expense_id) AS record_count
    FROM items
    WHERE item <> ''
    GROUP BY LOWER(item)
)
SELECT item_name, record_count
FROM item_counts
ORDER BY record_count DESC, item_name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE LOWER(a.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE LOWER(a2.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-'
ORDER BY s.full_name;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p
  ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.height_cm > 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM superhero AS dc
            JOIN publisher AS dcp
              ON dcp.id = dc.publisher_id
            JOIN hero_power AS dchp
              ON dchp.hero_id = dc.id
            WHERE dcp.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
              AND dchp.power_id = hp.power_id
        )
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad');

WITH power_counts AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT h.id, h.gender_id
    FROM superhero AS h
    JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = h.hair_colour_id
    JOIN power_counts AS pc ON pc.hero_id = h.id
    WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'
      AND pc.power_count >= 10
)
SELECT g.gender, COUNT(q.id) AS hero_count
FROM gender AS g
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
GROUP BY g.id, g.gender
ORDER BY CASE g.gender
    WHEN 'Male' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Female' THEN 2
END;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
    JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE r.race = 'God / Eternal'
      AND g.gender = 'Male'
    GROUP BY s.id
);

WITH target_publisher AS (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
),
race_counts AS (
    SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
    WHERE s.publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM target_publisher)
      AND s.race_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.race IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(r.race) <> ''
      AND r.race <> '-'
    GROUP BY r.id, r.race
)
SELECT race, superhero_count
FROM race_counts
WHERE superhero_count = (SELECT MAX(superhero_count) FROM race_counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg))
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg <> 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND p.power_name = 'Flight'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg < 70;

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE r.race = 'Human'
  AND s.height_cm = (
      SELECT MIN(s2.height_cm)
      FROM superhero AS s2
      JOIN race AS r2 ON r2.id = s2.race_id
      WHERE r2.race = 'Human'
        AND s2.height_cm > 0
  );

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-';

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0 THEN p.ID END) AS REAL)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5 THEN p.ID END), 0)
  AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday) > '10-09') AS age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.GLU >= 180
      AND l."T-CHO" < 250
);

SELECT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS completed_age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE l.PT >= 14
      AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
      AND date(p.Birthday) <= date('2026-10-09', '-56 years')
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage_female
FROM eligible;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP LIKE '%+%'
  AND p.Description IS NULL;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.Date,
        CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS anti_dna
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
      AND p.Admission = '+'
      AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
),
max_level AS (
    SELECT MAX(anti_dna) AS highest_level
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT e.ID, e.Date, e.anti_dna
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN max_level AS m ON e.anti_dna = m.highest_level
ORDER BY e.ID;

SELECT MAX(CAST(L.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_anti_rnp_value
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '+'
  AND L.RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(L.RNP) <> '';

SELECT SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE ALB < 3.5
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
      AND e.Thrombosis > 0
),
patient_results AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.RNP IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_result,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) > 64 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clearly_elevated
    FROM cohort AS c
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = c.ID
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_result = 1 AND clearly_elevated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN has_result = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM patient_results;

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
       - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.LDH > 600
        AND l.LDH < 800
        AND (
            CASE
                WHEN l."U-PRO" GLOB '>=*' THEN CAST(substr(l."U-PRO", 3) AS REAL)
                WHEN l."U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL)
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) >= 300
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT AVG(HCT)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date >= '1991-01-01'
  AND Date < '1992-01-01'
  AND HCT IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST("U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
    OR (
      "U-PRO" LIKE '>=%'
      AND CAST(SUBSTR("U-PRO", 3) AS REAL) >= 300
    )
  );

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.CPK < 250
  AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 4
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS ldh
    WHERE ldh.ID = p.ID
      AND ldh.LDH >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS protein
    WHERE protein.ID = p.ID
      AND (
          CAST(protein.`U-PRO` AS REAL) >= 100
          OR protein.`U-PRO` IN ('+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000')
      )
)
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND `First Date` BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%';

SELECT p.ID, e.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC, p.ID ASC, e.`Examination Date` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CASE SEX
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'male'
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'female'
    END AS sex,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.GPT >= 60
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  );

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
);

WITH molecule_groups AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM bond AS b
                WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
                  AND (b.bond_type IS NULL OR b.bond_type <> '-')
            ) THEN 'all_single'
            ELSE 'other'
        END AS bond_group
    FROM molecule AS m
)
SELECT
    bond_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule_groups
GROUP BY bond_group
ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2
    WHEN a2.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id
END)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

WITH rare_elements AS (
  SELECT element
  FROM atom
  WHERE element IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY element
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
),
rare_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN rare_elements AS r ON r.element = a.element
),
relevant_bonds AS (
  SELECT ra.molecule_id, c.bond_id
  FROM rare_atoms AS ra
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = ra.atom_id
  WHERE c.bond_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  SELECT ra.molecule_id, c.bond_id
  FROM rare_atoms AS ra
  JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id2 = ra.atom_id
  WHERE c.bond_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ra.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT rb.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM rare_atoms AS ra
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = ra.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN relevant_bonds AS rb ON rb.molecule_id = ra.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY ra.molecule_id
ORDER BY ra.molecule_id;
SELECT ROUND(2.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR397') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR397'), 2);

SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN a.element <= a2.element
            THEN a.element || '|' || a2.element
        ELSE a2.element || '|' || a.element
    END) AS element_pair_count,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2
    ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind_symbol ASC;
